text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: —*Sniff*, u-ugh...

text_block_list.name: Biko & Meno
text_block_list.text:
Justice Biko arrives!
Are you all right?! Officer on the scene!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, that was a relief.
Her parents were located immediately.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Totally! But still, as expected of
Fenomeno-senpai! Never missing even the tiniest
cry for help—now that's an admirable police officer!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply honored. You were quite
the hero yourself, Biko-san.
Neither of us could simply overlook such a situation.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! ...Hey, hey, since we're already at it,
wanna patrol together today?
Let's team up and give our best as champions of justice!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an excellent proposition! Fufufu.
Looking forward to working with you, Biko-san!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, there's trash on the ground!
I'll go pick it up!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Litter here as well... Looking closely,
there appears to be refuse scattered all over.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's weird... This shopping street
was supposed to be really focused on clean-up activities...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Scattered garbage is a sign of deteriorating public order...
Let us investigate the refuse and its surrounding area.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, while there are cigarettes and empty cans,
judging by this logo mark,
it seems to all come from the same store.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I recognize that!
It's that shop everyone's been talking about lately!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, my dad mentioned it.
Said a new branch opened up near here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Store Manager! Your trash cans are overflowing!
Shouldn't you swap out the bags?

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, my apologies...
I'll take care of it right away!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so the trash cans were indeed the source.
...Yet, would that alone be enough to make
the town this messy...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Do you have any idea why litter has been
scattering about lately? Anything at all,
even the smallest detail, would be of assistance.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident
text_block_list.text:
Well... ever since that shop opened,
a lot of people have started coming by.
With all the unfamiliar faces, public order has been, well...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Public order got worse? Besides the trash,
did anything else make you feel that way?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, rumors have it that folks from the back alleys
have been showing up. It's sketchy around there,
so the townspeople usually steer clear, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The back alleys... Just to be sure,
it would be wise to check on them.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That led to a brand new clue!
Fenomeno-senpai, you're super good at questioning people!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My father is a detective, so I have been influenced by him.
You too, Biko-san, are remarkably knowledgeable about the town.
Thanks to that, our inquiries went smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So this is the back alley...
There sure is a lot of graffiti. The vibe is pretty bad...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There is a possibility that public order is deteriorating further.
We cannot leave this unattended.
Let us investigate while remaining on high alert!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Hey, hey, almost every house around here
has weird graffiti on it...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Almost every house?
...Numbers, and alphabetical characters.
Could this style of notation be—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Burglary signs?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-Burglary?!
That's actual crime!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While not confirmed with absolute certainty,
it would be prudent to consult the police.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Call 110—wait, no.
My dad told me that if it's not an emergency,
you should call the local police station directly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by a nearby alleyway, I saw
Biko Pegasus and Fenomeno
making quite a commotion.
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! In fact, we were just
thinking of consulting the police!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I contacted the police station on their behalf
and reported that suspected burglar marking graffiti
had been found on neighboring houses.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The police should take care of the rest.
That's a huge relief!
choice_data_list: You two did a splendid job.
You two did a wonderful job.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am truly glad that we were able
to prevent a crime before it could take place!
choice_data_list: As expected of police officers' children.
You really take after your police officer parents.
You protected the peace of the residents. That's remarkable.
You protected the town's peace. Truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am truly glad that we were able
to prevent a crime before it could take place!
choice_data_list: As expected of police officers' children.
You really take after your police officer parents.
You protected the peace of the residents. That's remarkable.
You protected the town's peace. Truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Sir! I am honored by your praise!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, hearing that makes it feel like
my dad's being praised too! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Next time I see my dad, I'm gonna tell him
all about today! I bet he'll be super happy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As a member of the morals committee, upholding justice
properly even outside the academy brings me immense pride.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I feel like I really helped people
like a true hero should.
Nothing feels better than this!
